title: the Rust Belt Rising
author: Beatrix Yarrow
blurb: Odile Voss, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
